case_dispositions.reason: Retain the direct reproduction and precise release boundary, remove the broad test matrix and dispat promotion, and add the ASF-required public AI label.

The body reproduces the checked-in post-upload commit/tag shell block in two clones: an ordinary branch advance makes push exit 1, leaves no remote tag, yet the unconditional summary claims publication/tag success. It explicitly says no PyPI/production failure was observed and supplies current successful-run controls. The prior maintainer context identified this Python path as residual work after #181.

The comment concisely adds two run sequences. In the verified August case npm packages/tags completed, preparation failed before either marketplace, then a maintainer-triggered retry found nothing unpublished, skipped both marketplaces, and went green. It scopes out later manual completion.

The full body links pinned workflow conditions and retained attempts, covering 2,238 workflow runs and identifying the two matching sequences. It proves a per-destination recovery gap after npm succeeds, while avoiding claims about later marketplace state or Changesets fault.

discovery_only.qualification: Not a reviewed-project or defect count. Search scope differs from eight-inventory union.

limits: No uniform defect coding or rate is derived. No claim of 211 defective projects.
At least 211 is a conservative auditable bound; other audits are not comprehensively merged.
Inventories include selected screening, source/registry review, issue-history review and narrower reproductions; not 211 equivalent deep audits.
Stars measure repository visibility, not code size, team size, adoption or reliability.
Astro histories establish skipped steps on particular retries, not present marketplace state or universal Changesets behavior.
RelayCast simulates publication; Arrow uses a stubbed workflow client. Neither fixture establishes a production incident.
Later rejected Netty, Dartway, Svelte, SWC, Spec Kit, TMA and Playwright claims are not selected as supporting cases. Reviewed subjects remain in coverage totals.
Identifying original paths and authorship-bearing public issue URLs are local provenance, not an anonymous upload package.
